# Anurag Raut

> Senior React Native Developer with 5+ years shipping production Android and iOS apps across banking, FinTech and GovTech. Based in Pune, India and open to remote roles and focused mobile engagements.

Anurag Raut is a senior mobile engineer focused on React Native architecture, performance, reliability and delivery ownership. This site is a personal portfolio and engineering publication called Field Notes.
